name: Forever Yours
source:
Viola has been in love with Lucas for two years now. Sadly he has not returned her feelings. One day Viola writes their names in the sand on the beach and prays to God that she will be together with the love of her life. But it’s just wishful thinking, right? So then why does Lucas come to the pub where Viola works the next day and declare he is her boyfriend?!

A short and bittersweet visual novel where you get to decide the fate of Viola’s love.

[From [url=https://lavinnia.itch.io/forever-yours]Itch.io[/url]]
